"""Hand-derived expectations from PROTOCOL.md, checked against the C engine."""
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project')
import harness  # noqa

fails = 0


def check(name, case, expect_state=None, expect_packets=None, expect_bytes=None,
          expect_trace_psns=None, expect_buffer=None):
    global fails
    got = harness.solve([case])['cases'][0]
    problems = []
    if expect_state is not None:
        st = got['state']
        for idx, want in expect_state.items():
            if st[idx] != want:
                problems.append('state[%d]=%r want %r' % (idx, st[idx], want))
    if expect_packets is not None and got['packets'] != expect_packets:
        problems.append('packets=%r want %r' % (got['packets'], expect_packets))
    if expect_bytes is not None and got['bytes'] != expect_bytes:
        problems.append('bytes=%r want %r' % (got['bytes'], expect_bytes))
    if expect_buffer is not None and got['buffer'] != expect_buffer:
        problems.append('buffer=%r want %r' % (got['buffer'], expect_buffer))
    if expect_trace_psns is not None:
        psns = [int(t['hex'][100:108], 16) & 0xffffff for t in got['trace']]
        if psns != expect_trace_psns:
            problems.append('trace psns=%r want %r' % (psns, expect_trace_psns))
    if problems:
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL', name)
        for p in problems:
            print('   ', p)
        print('    full state:', got['state'])
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)
    return got


def data(rank, p, values=None):
    ev = {'op': 'data', 'rank': rank, 'p': p}
    if values is not None:
        ev['values'] = values
    return ev


# Scenario 1: mode 2 allreduce, downstream ACK gates the upstream ACK, then
# retirement needs every output acknowledged and every source upstream-acked.
case = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 2, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 1, 'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [data(0, 0, [5]), data(1, 0, [7]), {'op': 'ack', 'rank': 0, 'upto': 1},
                   data(2, 0, [9]), data(3, 0, [11])]}
# after these: results sent to all four; the early ACK was ignored (sent was 0)
check('s1a mode2 early ack ignored', case,
      expect_state={0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 1, 3: 1, 4: 1, 5: 1, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 1, 9: 1,
                    10: 0, 11: 0, 12: 0, 13: 0, 14: 0, 15: 0, 16: 0, 17: 0,
                    18: 4, 19: 1, 20: 4, 21: 0, 22: 4, 23: 0, 24: 0, 25: 0,
                    28: 1, 29: 0},
      expect_packets=4, expect_bytes=4 * 66)

case['events'] = case['events'] + [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': r, 'upto': 1} for r in range(4)]
check('s1b mode2 ack cascade retires', case,
      expect_state={0: 1, 1: 0, 2: 1, 6: 1, 10: 1, 14: 1, 15: 1, 16: 1, 17: 1,
                    18: 4, 19: 5, 20: 4, 21: 4, 22: 4, 28: 1},
      expect_packets=8)

# Scenario 2: mode 3 allgather fan-out order and retirement after 3K ACKs.
case = {'primitive': 'allgather', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 1, 'start': 0, 'trace': 16,
        'events': [data(0, 0, [10]), data(1, 0, [20]), data(2, 0, [30]), data(3, 0, [40])]}
got = check('s2 allgather fanout', case,
            expect_state={0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 1, 6: 3, 7: 3, 8: 3, 9: 3, 14: 1, 18: 4,
                          19: 0, 20: 12, 21: 4, 22: 4},
            expect_packets=16)
# payload order: dest0 gets src1,src2,src3 (10*src values 20,30,40)
payloads = [int(t['hex'][-16:-8], 16) for t in got['trace'][4:]]
if payloads != [20, 30, 40, 10, 30, 40, 10, 20, 40, 10, 20, 30]:
    print('FAIL s2 payload order', payloads)
    fails += 1
case['events'] = case['events'] + [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': r, 'upto': 3} for r in range(4)]
check('s2b allgather retires', case, expect_state={0: 1, 1: 0, 10: 3, 11: 3, 12: 3, 13: 3},
      expect_packets=16)

# Scenario 3: retry retransmits only the unacknowledged tail, ACK repeat first.
case = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 2, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 2, 'start': 100, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [data(r, p) for p in (0, 1) for r in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': 0, 'upto': 1}, {'op': 'retry', 'rank': 0}]}
# 8 upstream ACKs (mode 3, one per source per p as R advances) + 8 results, then
# retry: one repeat ACK (prefix 2) plus retransmission of q=1 only.
got = check('s3 retry tail', case, expect_state={0: 0, 6: 2, 10: 1, 14: 2, 18: 8, 19: 1,
                                                 20: 9, 21: 9},
            expect_packets=18)

# Scenario 4: budget zero rejects the attempt, ends the opportunity, persists pending.
case = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 1, 'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [{'op': 'budget', 'n': 0}, data(0, 0, [1]), data(1, 0, [2]),
                   data(2, 0, [3]), data(3, 0, [4])]}
check('s4a budget blocked', case, expect_state={0: 0, 1: 1, 2: 1, 6: 0, 14: 0, 18: 4,
                                                 20: 0, 21: 0, 22: 4, 29: 1},
      expect_packets=0)
case['events'] = case['events'] + [{'op': 'budget', 'n': -1}, {'op': 'flush'}]
check('s4b budget released', case, expect_state={0: 0, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 1, 9: 1, 14: 1,
                                                 20: 4, 21: 1, 29: 1},
      expect_packets=5)
case['events'] = case['events'] + [{'op': 'flush'}, {'op': 'flush'}]
check('s4c nothing pending', case, expect_state={20: 4, 21: 1, 29: 1}, expect_packets=5)

# Scenario 5: duplicates keep the first payload and request an ACK repeat.
case = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 2, 'root': 0, 'segments': 2, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 2, 'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [data(0, 0, [5]), data(0, 0, [99]), data(1, 0, [7])]}
check('s5 duplicate first wins', case,
      expect_state={18: 3, 22: 2, 23: 1, 20: 0, 21: 0},
      expect_buffer=None)

# Scenario 6: blocked and stale DATA never allocate; stale asks for a repeat.
case = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 8, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 2, 'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [data(r, p) for p in (0, 1) for r in range(4)] +
                  [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': r, 'upto': 1} for r in range(4)] +
                  [data(0, 5), data(0, 0)]}
# after p=0 retires (complete, acked, U>p), b=1; p=5 >= b+N=3 -> blocked;
# p=0 < b -> stale and requests an ACK repeat to rank 0.
check('s6 blocked and stale', case,
      expect_state={0: 1, 1: 1, 18: 10, 22: 8, 24: 1, 25: 1, 21: 5},
      expect_packets=None)

# Scenario 7: barrier uses empty payloads and q=0 for all four ranks.
case = {'primitive': 'barrier', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 1, 'words': 0,
        'capacity': 1, 'start': 7, 'trace': 4,
        'events': [data(r, 0) for r in range(4)]}
got = check('s7 barrier', case, expect_state={0: 0, 1: 1, 6: 1, 7: 1, 8: 1, 9: 1,
                                              14: 1, 20: 4, 21: 4},
            expect_packets=8, expect_bytes=4 * 62 + 4 * 58,
            expect_buffer='cbf29ce484222325')
for t in got['trace'][4:]:
    if len(t['hex']) != 58 * 2:
        print('FAIL s7 frame length', len(t['hex']) // 2)
        fails += 1

# Scenario 8: reduce only feeds the root; ACKs from non-receivers are ignored.
case = {'primitive': 'reduce', 'mode': 2, 'root': 2, 'segments': 1, 'words': 2,
        'capacity': 1, 'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [data(r, 0) for r in range(4)] + [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': 0, 'upto': 1}]}
check('s8 reduce non-receiver ack', case,
      expect_state={0: 0, 6: 0, 7: 0, 8: 1, 9: 0, 10: 0, 14: 0, 15: 0, 16: 0, 17: 0,
                    19: 1, 20: 1, 28: 1},
      expect_packets=1)
case['events'] = case['events'] + [{'op': 'ack', 'rank': 2, 'upto': 1}]
check('s8b reduce root ack unlocks all sources', case,
      expect_state={0: 0, 10: 0, 12: 1, 14: 1, 15: 1, 16: 1, 17: 1, 21: 4},
      expect_packets=5)

# Scenario 9: reducescatter maps p to a single destination and q = p mod K/4.
case = {'primitive': 'reducescatter', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 8, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 8, 'start': 0, 'trace': 0,
        'events': [data(r, p) for p in range(8) for r in range(4)]}
got = check('s9 scatter mapping', case,
            expect_state={0: 0, 6: 2, 7: 2, 8: 2, 9: 2, 18: 32, 20: 8, 21: 8},
            expect_packets=16)

# Scenario 10: wrapped PSNs map back into the logical input space.
start = (1 << 24) - 2
case = {'primitive': 'allreduce', 'mode': 3, 'root': 0, 'segments': 4, 'words': 1,
        'capacity': 4, 'start': start, 'trace': 4,
        'events': [data(r, p) for p in range(4) for r in range(4)]}
got = check('s10 wrapped psn', case, expect_state={0: 0, 6: 4, 18: 16, 20: 16, 21: 16},
            expect_packets=32)
psns = [int(t['hex'][100:108], 16) & 0xffffff for t in got['trace'][:4]]
if psns != [start & 0xffffff, (start + 1) & 0xffffff, 0, 1]:
    print('FAIL s10 ack psns', psns)
    fails += 1

print('hand-check failures:', fails)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && timeout -s KILL 175 python3 -u dev/handchecks.py 2>&1 | tail -40
